description: Extracted verbatim from a real dashboard session (6 turns, single-lane): build and evolve a FastAPI service in the sandbox — inventory, create the app, verify, run the server, add a query endpoint, add data and re-verify. Exercises WRITE_FILE authoring, BASH programmatic verification and full service lifecycle; the server turns are checked with bash effect probes (any HTTP response on common ports proves the service is up) because the effect is a running process, not just files. Used to A/B the Noul ambiguity gate and progress-score floor against confidence-only escalation.

scenarios.description: Real workspace case: each turn continues the same sandbox, files and running services persist across turns; later turns restart the server after editing app code.
